title: Locally generated ideal-power products on an algebraic space
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $X$ an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], with its small etale site $X_{\mathrm{et}}$, structure sheaf $\mathcal O_X$ and category of module sheaves. Given module sheaves $I,F$ and a module morphism $i:I\to\mathcal O_X$, define $J_i(T)=\langle\operatorname{im}(i_T)\rangle\subseteq\mathcal O_X(T)$ for every test $T$. For a family of subsets $A(T)\subseteq F(T)$ and $n\in\mathbb N$, define $P_{i,F,A,n}(T)$ to consist of the sections $s\in F(T)$ for which there is a covering sieve $R$ on $T$ such that, for every $f:V\to T$ in $R$, the restriction $s|_V$ belongs to $J_i(V)^n\langle A(V)\rangle_{\mathcal O_X(V)}$. Here the brackets denote ideal or submodule generation, respectively. When $i$ is a monic ideal inclusion and $A$ is the section family of a submodule sheaf $N\subseteq F$, this is the section family of the locally generated ideal product $I^nN$; it includes exponent zero, with $I^0N=N$. In particular $A(T)=F(T)$ defines $I^nF$.
